caption:
Most owners track leads in a notebook, on a sticky note, or in their head.

Then the quote goes cold because nobody remembered to follow up.

Black Arrow OS fixes that. It's a free pocket CRM that lives in your browser.

Drag a lead across a visual pipeline. Set a follow-up date so it never slips. Check one dashboard for your weekly CPL and ROAS instead of guessing.

Free forever. No signup, no card, first 25 contacts on us. Export to CSV whenever you want your data.

rationale: Offers/Lead Magnets is the under-served category this cycle, and Black Arrow OS is next in the tool rotation after the AI Follow-Up Builder, shown as a single clean promo card, the format research confirms converts fastest for one clear offer.
